title: OWASP API Security Top 10 (2023)
notes: Risk names are OWASP's. The `requirement` text is docket's plain statement of the obligation each risk implies, not a quotation of OWASP's prose; `citation` locates the risk in the published list so the original is one click away. Nine of the ten are answerable by reading source. API9 is inventory and documentation governance, which a repository cannot settle, so it is marked process and is never handed to an agent.

controls.title: Broken Object Level Authorization
controls.requirement: Every handler that retrieves, updates or deletes an object identified by a client-supplied id must verify that the authenticated caller is authorised for that specific object, not merely authenticated.
controls.evidence_hint: route handlers taking an id from the path, query or body; ORM get-by-primary-key calls with no owner/tenant filter; a decorator that checks login but not ownership

controls.title: Broken Authentication
controls.requirement: Authentication endpoints and token handling must be implemented correctly: credentials verified against a strong password hash, tokens signed and validated with a verified algorithm and secret, session and token lifetimes bounded, and credential-stuffing or brute-force attempts rate limited.
controls.evidence_hint: jwt.decode without verify/algorithms pinned; md5/sha1 or plain comparison of passwords; login routes with no throttle; tokens with no expiry claim

controls.title: Broken Object Property Level Authorization
controls.requirement: Endpoints must control which object properties a caller may read or write: responses must not expose properties the caller is not entitled to, and writes must not accept client-supplied values for properties only the server may set.
controls.evidence_hint: serializers with no field allowlist; Model(**request.json) or Object.assign(model, req.body); returning a whole ORM row including password_hash, is_admin or internal flags

controls.title: Unrestricted Resource Consumption
controls.requirement: APIs must bound the resources a single caller can consume: request rate, request and upload body size, page size on list endpoints, query depth or complexity, and timeouts on outbound calls.
controls.evidence_hint: rate-limit middleware present and applied; MAX_CONTENT_LENGTH or body-parser limit set; list endpoints with a capped page size; requests/fetch calls passing a timeout

controls.title: Broken Function Level Authorization
controls.requirement: Administrative and privileged operations must enforce a role or permission check at the handler, and that check must not be inferable only from the route name or client-side routing.
controls.evidence_hint: admin routes with no role decorator or guard; permission checks applied to some handlers in a blueprint but not others; a middleware allowlist that a new route silently misses

controls.title: Unrestricted Access to Sensitive Business Flows
controls.requirement: Business flows whose automated abuse causes harm (registration, purchase, transfer, redemption, messaging) must carry a control beyond authentication, such as throttling, a challenge, device or behaviour checks, or a server-side limit per account.
controls.evidence_hint: signup/checkout/transfer handlers; whether any per-account or per-ip counter, captcha hook or idempotency key guards them

controls.title: Server Side Request Forgery
controls.requirement: Where the API fetches a remote resource at a URL influenced by the client, the destination must be validated against an allowlist and redirects must not be followed to unvalidated hosts.
controls.evidence_hint: requests.get / fetch / http.request / urlopen whose URL derives from request data; webhook, avatar-import, preview and pdf-render features; absence of a host allowlist or of allow_redirects=False

controls.title: Security Misconfiguration
controls.requirement: The deployed configuration must be hardened: debug mode off, stack traces not returned to clients, CORS not open to arbitrary origins with credentials, security headers set, default credentials absent, and unnecessary HTTP methods disabled.
controls.evidence_hint: DEBUG=True, app.run(debug=True), NODE_ENV not pinned; CORS allow_origin='*' together with allow_credentials; error handlers returning exception text; hardcoded default admin credentials

controls.title: Improper Inventory Management
controls.requirement: The organisation must maintain a current inventory of API hosts, versions and environments, publish documentation for each, and decommission retired versions rather than leaving them reachable.

controls.title: Unsafe Consumption of APIs
controls.requirement: Data received from third-party and upstream APIs must be validated and bounded before use, transport to them must be encrypted and certificate-verified, and their redirects must not be blindly followed.
controls.evidence_hint: verify=False or rejectUnauthorized:false on outbound calls; upstream JSON passed straight into a database write, template or eval; no schema check on a webhook payload
